expires_today.title: GenAI & Agentic AI by BPB
expires_today.long_description: Be on the cutting edge of the new technological frontier with this bundle of instructional ebooks and training manuals all about generative and agentic AI! Learn how to scale genAI models with Kubernetes and LangChain, discover practical real-world approaches to using agentic AI and autonomous systems, and find out how to build them yourself to suit your needs! Learn how AI works from the inside so you can use it to optimize just about everything. Pay what you want for this bundle of 17 ebooks about everything AI, and support regenerative agriculture charity Kiss the Ground with your purchase!

expires_today.title: The Complete Java Developer Bundle
expires_today.long_description:
Whether you’re a seasoned software developer or just getting the hang of a couple programming languages, this bundle of training resources has everything you need to master Java! Learn hands-on tactics for designing CI/CD pipelines with Jenkins, master the basics of Java Spring Framework and Selenium WebDriver, find out how to problem-solve and troubleshoot with data structures and algorithms, and more! This bundle of over 25 training course packages is perfect for those who simply need a Java refresher or anyone who’s just starting out! Grab this bundle now at the price of your choice, and support ocean ecosystem charity Coral Guardian with your purchase!

Keys expire. Please redeem your keys before October 28th, 2027.

expires_today.title: Unity Powerhouse Bundle
expires_today.long_description:
Make video games that look like they took years to design—in no time at all! With this massive collection of tools and assets for Unity, you can fill your games with detail and atmosphere and have them ready to play before you know it. Build complete game worlds with ready-to-use characters, environments, biomes, and props. Explore collections of terrain and environment stamps, design ready-to-use industrial cityscapes, experiment with dynamic lighting and fog effects, and more! Create, experiment, prototype, and bring your ideas to life with a wide variety of production-ready Unity assets, many of which have never been featured in a Humble Bundle before! Get this huge bundle of assets for the price of your choosing, and support the Make-A-Wish Foundation with your purchase!

Keys expire. Please redeem your keys before October 31, 2027.

expires_today.title: Dark Places and Endless Night: Sheer Horror by IDW
expires_today.long_description: The days are getting colder, the nights are getting longer, and spooky season is officially upon us. Lean into the scary vibes with this bundle of horror comics and graphic novels from IDW! Explore an idyllic small town of anthropomorphic animals protected by a serial killer bear in the Richard Scarry-esque murder mystery Beneath the Trees Where Nobody Sees! Follow an all-women crew of inmate firefighters as they stage a heist during a rampaging California wildfire in the first of Scott Snyder’s anthology series Dark Spaces: Wildfire! Discover the truth of a strange sleeping illness in the graphic novel adaptation of Stephen and Owen King’s Sleeping Beauties! Survive the bloody horrors of the vampire-infested Alaska town in the Deluxe Edition of 30 Days of Night! All of these and more are included in this spooky bundle of horror comics, so grab them now at the price of your choosing and support BINC with your purchase!

expires_today.title: The Best of Brian W. Aldiss by Open Road Media
expires_today.description: Sci-fi like you’ve never seen it before
expires_today.long_description: Far off worlds! Dangerous Edens! The future of humanity and beyond! Read the works of a true master of science fiction with this massive bundle of ebooks by Brian W. Aldiss! Visit a planet with seasons that last for centuries and civilizations in constant conflict in Helliconia Spring! Discover the secrets behind a mad scientist’s beastly creations in An Island Called Moreau! Follow a utopian Mars colony as they fight to survive against insurmountable odds in Finches of Mars! All of these adventures and more are included in this bundle of over 40 fantastic ebooks by a true master of the genre. Get them now at the price of your choosing, and support Active Minds charity with your purchase!

expires_today.title: Kurt Busiek's Astro City: The 30th Anniversary by Image Comics
expires_today.long_description: Celebrate multi‑time Eisner and Harvey Award winner author Kurt Busiek’s most popular works with The 30th Anniversary Bundle by Image Comics! Lose yourself in the complete Astro City series! How do average people, support teams, and even villains navigate day‑to‑day life in a world where being truly super is possible—read volumes 1‑17 and see what makes Astro City so unforgettable. Or explore The Autumnlands, an epic tale that melds mature themes with high‑fantasy wizardry! Pay what you want for critically acclaimed comics and help support The BINC Foundation with your purchase!

expires_tomorrow.title: Amazing Creator-Owned Comics by DSTLRY
expires_tomorrow.long_description:
Celebrate an all-star lineup of comics creators and the publisher that makes it all happen with this collection of favorites from DSTLRY! Every DSTLRY book is creator-owned, so your support goes directly to the people who make the comics. Embark on a tense time-travel yarn in Time Waits, a sci-fi adventure from Chip Zdarsky, David Brothers, and Marcus To! Uncover the secrets of a fantastical floating city in Simon Spurrier and Matías Bergara's A Mischief of Magpies! Survive the witch hunts and awaken supernatural beings in Becky Cloonan and Tula Lotay's erotic folk-horror Somna! Discover even more incredible stories and journeys into the unknown in this bundle of more than 40 fan-favorite comics! Name your price, and support the Book Industry Charitable Foundation (BINC) with your purchase!

Available on Neon Ichiban, with DRM-free downloads.

expires_tomorrow.title: Make Your Own Games In Unreal
expires_tomorrow.long_description:
Learn how to create your own video games in Unreal Engine with the power of C++ from the pros at GameDev.tv! This all-new Humble Video Learning Bundle contains everything you need to learn the fundamentals. Master modern game development with comprehensive courses designed to help you succeed quickly, including Math For Video Games, FPS Music Asset, and Unreal Engine Blueprint Game Developer. Get the expert education you seek from the professionals at GameDev.tv, and help support Girls Who Code with your purchase!

Keys expire. Please redeem your keys before October 29th, 2027.

expires_tomorrow.title: Beyond Reality: Sci-Fi & Survival VR Collection
expires_tomorrow.long_description:
Blast off to faraway stars or stay home and hide from monsters in the woods with this bundle of sci-fi and horror (and sci-fi horror) VR games! Explore a derelict spaceship while fighting off an entity determined to mutate your own body in Star Trek: Infection! Command a fleet of ships through evolving stages of space battles in Homeworld: Vast Reaches! Run through the woods finding stick figures and hiding from a creature of terror and darkness in Blair Witch VR! Fully immerse yourself in outer space adventures and Earthbound terror with these VR games! Get them all now at the price of your choice and support HPV Cancers Alliance with your purchase!

Keys expire. Please redeem and activate on Steam before April 28th, 2027.

expires_tomorrow.title: Indie Fighters
expires_tomorrow.long_description:

expires_tomorrow.title: The Ultimate Gene Wolfe Library by Tor Books
expires_tomorrow.description: New suns, ancient lands, and beyond
expires_tomorrow.long_description: Sci-fi and fantasy master Gene Wolfe’s novels and long-running series span all facets of genre fiction, each one unlike anything else ever written. Enter the world of the genre-bending Book of the New Sun series with the Dying Earth fantasy of Shadow and Claw!
